name: Filter-toolbar-bar
purpose: The control bar that sits above a table or list: a search field, 0-2 filter dropdowns, a view/sort switch, and an optional row of dismissible applied-filter chips. Composed ENTIRELY from existing gated atoms (Search-field, Dropdown, Segmented-control, Tags) — no new visual vocabulary, only arrangement. Itinerary row 120 (Layer 2, class NO-ARTEFACT-CLASS at mint; PROPOSED here, not ruled).

props.name: density
props.$note: Structural variance (a different assembly, not a scaled param) — routes to the VARIANTS axis, the same reading Tags' own `type` prop carries (s142-D1 class C6). Full = search + N dropdowns + view switch + chip row (arrangement A). Compact = underline search + sm segmented control only, for sitting directly above a table/list (arrangement B, the itinerary row's own stated context).

props.name: filterCount
props.$note: 0-N Dropdown instances. The organism does not draw a new dropdown style.

props.name: appliedFilters
props.$note: 0-N dismissible Tags, each removable via the atom's own × control; the organism supplies none of the dismiss mechanics itself.

variants.name: full
variants.use: Search + filter dropdowns + a Segmented-control view switch, with an applied-filters chip row underneath.

variants.name: compact
variants.use: A dense bar directly above a Table/List-items region — underline search + a small segmented control (sort/view), no chip row.

tokens.search: form/border/* + form/background/hover via Search-field.reference.html (boxed variant), unmodified
tokens.filters: the full dropdown/menu/listbox token set via Dropdown.reference.html (boxed variant), unmodified
tokens.view: tertiary/background/* + secondary/background/default via Segmented-control.reference.html, unmodified — PROMOTED off View-options (Dave, 2026-07-24), so this organism consumes Segmented-control, not the superseded file
tokens.chips: form/border/default + the applied-filters container-query collapse via Tags.reference.html, unmodified
tokens.$note: Every token above resolves through the ATOM's own manifest; this organism binds nothing new. The bar's own CSS (`.ftb-*`) is flex arrangement only.

responsive.$status: PROPOSED at #210 wave-5 (not ruled) — reflow verified in a real browser at 3 widths.
responsive.rule: Wide: one row (search grows, filters share space, view switch pinned right). Container <=680px: search claims the full row width, filters + view switch wrap beneath it. Container <=400px (WCAG 1.4.10 reachable to 320px): every control stacks full-width, including the segmented control's own buttons (flex:1). The applied-filter chip row collapses to one-chip-per-row at <=360px via Tags' OWN unmodified container query.
responsive.$note: s210-D3 discipline: the bar declares no width of its own; the container gives it one.

livesInside: Page (above a Table or List-items region)
commonPatterns: compact sort bar above a table

accessibility.structure: Search-field keeps its own type="search"/aria-label; Dropdown keeps its own role="combobox"/listbox/option triad; Segmented-control keeps its own role="group"+aria-pressed; Tags keeps its own aria-label per dismiss button — all unmodified from the source atom.
accessibility.focus: Every borrowed atom keeps its OWN :focus-visible ring — the organism adds no new focusable element and no new focus style.

antiPatterns: Re-drawing the search field, dropdown, segmented control or chip CSS instead of composing the existing atom — the #202 defect this brief names explicitly
Consuming View-options instead of Segmented-control for the view switch — View-options was superseded 2026-07-24
Giving the bar a fixed width — s210-D3 reserves that for the container
Selecting a filter state by colour alone — Dropdown's aria-selected + Segmented-control's aria-pressed already carry the non-colour signal
